approaches.name: single pass with a running count

steps.title: Clarify the input
steps.description: States what an empty list returns and whether a reading equal to the threshold counts as quiet.
look_for: asks whether equal to the threshold is quiet
hints: Before you code, is there anything about the input you'd want to pin down?
What should happen if there are no readings at all?
Settle the empty list and the equal-to-threshold case before you start.

steps.title: Count a streak that reaches the end
steps.description: Records the best length for a streak that is still running when the loop ends.
look_for: updates the best length after the loop
updates the best length on every quiet reading
hints: Look at what happens on your last reading.
If the longest quiet stretch is at the very end, when does your code record it?
A streak can end because the list ends, not only because of a loud reading.

common_mistakes.description: only updates the best length when a loud reading appears
common_mistakes.symptom: fails when the longest streak runs to the end of the list

wrap_up_questions: What are the time and space complexity?
How would you change this if readings arrived one at a time as a stream?

origin_note: Original. Pattern: single pass with a running counter.
